title: TermSheet AI Attribute Schema
description: JSON schema for extracting specific clause variables and their source text spans. Use null for any field not stated in the document.

source_span.description: The exact quote from the document proving these liquidation values.

participation.description: True if investors have participating preferred rights, false if non-participating.

cap.description: Participation cap as a multiple of the original purchase price (e.g., 3 means 3x). Null if no cap.

source_span.description: The exact quote proving the vesting schedule.

vesting_months.description: Total duration of the vesting schedule in months (e.g., 48).

cliff_months.description: The cliff period in months (e.g., 12). Null if no cliff.

source_span.description: The exact quote proving the board composition.

investor_seats.description: Number of board seats controlled by investors.

founder_seats.description: Number of board seats controlled by founders.
